messages:
ana_fp&a: Noticed a customer complaint: reseller EdgeWave Partners was charged full monthly minimum on invoice INV-2026-1104 despite the partner having a monthly seat cap posted. Can someone confirm? :grimacing:

tyler_billing: Give me the line details and partner id?

ana_fp&a: Partner ID CH-2043. Invoice excerpt:
```
INV-2026-1104 | Partner: EdgeWave Partners | SKU: EW-MON-SEAT | Seats billed: 120 | Seat Cap: 100 | Rate: $12/seat | Amount billed: $1,440.00
Expected: cap enforcement -> bill 100 seats = $1,200.00 -> diff $240 credit
```

kira_revenueops: Running mediation logs now. billing-run shows cap enforcement flag set=false for CH-2043 on 2026-04-11. Looks like partner metadata didn't sync.

billingbot: Invoice INV-2026-1104 generated by marketplace-mediator v1.9.4 at 2026-04-11T22:03:12Z. Partner metadata last-sync: 2026-03-30T03:02:10Z.

marta_audit: If metadata last-sync predates cap update, that's likely root cause. Do we have evidence of partner cap change?

kira_revenueops: I see a partner update event in partner-ops: `UPDATE_PARTNER_CAP CH-2043 cap=100` on 2026-04-08T08:15:44Z. It didn't propagate to mediation, need to trace webhook queue.

tyler_billing: For remediation: propose a credit memo for $240, GL 4330. Also add a retrofix to re-run mediation for April invoices if webhook replays succeed.

ana_fp&a: Please also notify EdgeWave's AE and include apology + ETA for credit. They reported via partner-support ticket PS-4021.

billingbot: Partner support ticket PS-4021 linked to invoice INV-2026-1104.

marta_audit: I'll add audit trail entries and request partner consent for retro adjustment. We should avoid mass retro runs unless webhook backlog is confirmed small.

kira_revenueops: I've opened infra ticket INF-6904: investigate webhook delivery failures between partner-ops and marketplace-mediator. Tagged eng-infra and eng-sre.

tyler_billing: I'll add a row to billing-reconcile sheet with calculation + logs. Link when ready.

an a_fp&a: Thanks. Please don't issue credit until partner confirms acceptance and finance signs off. Will follow up with AE and update here. :white_check_mark:
